verdict.rationale: Kit's pricing page lists its own 'Unlimited Visual Automations' feature, which suggests event-triggered automation rules. However, the evidence never describes the triggers, conditions or actions. Webhooks only let external integrations react to events, a developer building block, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of event triggers and rule/condition definitions, the list of supported automated actions, any AI-native or agent-driven way to define rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
